title: Improve UI-interaction to change viewrange on overview (feature request)
symptom: The user finds the current UI interaction to change the view range on the overview (tab-hold-and-wait for rendering) tedious and unresponsive, often overshooting the desired range and having to repeat the process.
fix: The issue was resolved in the current v3.2 UI, as stated by vanelsberg: 'Solved for current v3.2 UI...'
